_about: English version of data/skilldetails.json for the GU mode (same keys = Japanese effect names). Hand-translated.
属性攻撃強化: Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice and Dragon damage ×1.1
属性攻撃弱化: Fire, Water, Thunder, Ice and Dragon damage ×0.9
状態異常攻撃+2: Poison, Paralysis, Sleep and Tranq buildup ×1.2 +1
状態異常攻撃+1: Poison, Paralysis, Sleep and Tranq buildup ×1.1 +1
状態異常攻撃弱化: Poison, Paralysis, Sleep and Tranq buildup ×0.9
会心撃【属性】: Element damage on a critical hit: Great Sword ×1.2, Light / Heavy Bowgun ×1.3, Sword & Shield, Dual Blades, Bow ×1.35, others ×1.25
会心撃【特殊】: Status buildup on a critical hit (Paralysis, Poison, Sleep) ×1.2
連撃の心得: Hitting gives affinity +25%; keep hitting within 5 s for up to +30%. Ends after 5 s without a hit
業物: Halves the sharpness lost from attacks, Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire, Great Sword and Charge Blade guards, etc. Bounces lose the same as before
鈍器使い: The worse the sharpness, the higher the attack: blue no change, green ×1.1, yellow ×1.15, orange / red ×1.2
剛刃研磨: After sharpening, sharpness does not drop for 1 minute (gunners: some sources say attack ×1.75)
未熟: Even on parts that normally don't bounce, attacks bounce 1/3 of the time
抜刀術【力】: Draw attacks of cutting weapons add 30 stun and 20 exhaust. Base attack +5
KO術: Stun ×1.1 (not the Insect Glaive kinsect's attacks)
スタミナ奪取: Exhaust ×1.2 (impact, Punishing Draw slashes, Exhaust shots, Bow arc shots, Exhaust Coatings)
弱点特効: Affinity up when hitting parts with a hitzone of 45 or more
破壊王: Damage to part durability ×1.3 (flinches more easily). Attack is not raised. No effect on parts already broken
力の解放+2: Activates after taking 180 damage in total or 5 minutes after a large monster spots you. For 90 s: affinity +50%, stamina use 1/4
力の解放+1: Activates after taking 180 damage in total or 5 minutes after a large monster spots you. For 90 s: affinity +30%, stamina use 1/2
挑戦者+2: From 3 s after a large monster gets angry: attack +25, affinity +20%
挑戦者+1: From 3 s after a large monster gets angry: attack +10, affinity +10%
フルチャージ: Base attack +20 while health is full
火事場力+2: At 40% health or less: defense +30–45, attack ×1.3
心配性: At 40% health or less: defense -21–30, attack ×0.7
不屈: After fainting once: attack ×1.1, defense +15%; twice: attack ×1.3, defense +30%
砲術王: Ballista, cannon, Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire ×1.2; Charge Blade impact phials and Cluster shots ×1.3. Wyvern's Fire cooldown 120 s → 90 s
砲術師: Ballista, cannon, Gunlance shells and Wyvern's Fire ×1.1; Charge Blade impact phials and Cluster shots ×1.15
ボマー: Bomb damage ×1.3. Blast buildup ×1.2 (×1.25 with Felyne Pyro). Bomb combining always succeeds
集中: Great Sword, Hammer and Bow charge time ×0.8. Long Sword, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill ×1.2
雑念: Great Sword, Hammer and Bow charge time ×1.2. Long Sword, Dual Blades and Switch Axe gauges fill ×0.8
乗り名人: Mount buildup ×1.25. Attack gauge while mounted ×1.25
乗り下手: Mount buildup ×0.9. Attack gauge while mounted ×0.9
ガード性能+2: Less pushback when guarding (guarded hit strength -20)
ガード性能+1: Less pushback when guarding (guarded hit strength -10)
ガード性能-1: More pushback when guarding (guarded hit strength +10)
根性: With 64 or more health, survive one hit that would make you faint (works again after fainting)
英雄の護り: Nullifies small damage (5 or less), and also status, item and damage-over-time attacks
切り札: Against large monsters, for 1 minute after a chance such as a mount topple: Hunter Art damage and duration ×1.2 (some arts get extra effects)
刃鱗磨き: Evading with your weapon drawn: blademasters regain 5 sharpness (7 with Seregios weapons), bowguns load 1 shot (+1 at 50%), Bow close-range coating damage ×1.5 (×1.65 with Seregios weapons)
龍気活性: When hit by Dragonblight at 2/3 health or less: all resistances +50, attack ×1.1
体術+1: Stamina used by evading and guarding ×0.75
体術-1: Stamina used by evading and guarding ×1.2
体術-2: Stamina used by evading and guarding ×1.35
キープラン: Stamina does not drop at 25 or less (while red)
拾い食い: Eating meat raises max stamina by another 25. Some items raise stamina too
まんぷく: Eating meat raises max stamina by another 25
お肉大好き: You can eat Raw Meat, max stamina +50. Rare Steak, Well-done Steak, Chilled Meat and Hot Meat give the Mega Dash effect for 1 minute
満足感: Meat and drinks are not used up 25% of the time
アイテム使用強化: Drugs, drinks, seeds and pills last ×2
アイテム使用弱化: Drugs, drinks, seeds and pills last ×2/3
火耐性【大】: Fire resistance +20. Over 20 in total, nullifies Fireblight (both kinds)
火耐性【小】: Fire resistance +15. Over 10 in total, nullifies minor Fireblight
水耐性【大】: Water resistance +20. Over 20 in total, nullifies Waterblight (both kinds)
水耐性【小】: Water resistance +15. Over 10 in total, nullifies minor Waterblight
氷耐性【大】: Ice resistance +20. Over 20 in total, nullifies Iceblight (both kinds)
氷耐性【小】: Ice resistance +15. Over 10 in total, nullifies minor Iceblight
雷耐性【大】: Thunder resistance +20. Over 20 in total, nullifies Thunderblight (both kinds)
雷耐性【小】: Thunder resistance +15. Over 10 in total, nullifies minor Thunderblight
龍耐性【大】: Dragon resistance +20. Over 20 in total, nullifies Dragonblight (both kinds)
龍耐性【小】: Dragon resistance +15. Over 10 in total, nullifies minor Dragonblight
気絶確率半減: When about to be stunned, 1/2 chance not to be
バイオドクター: Dung Bombs always make monsters leave the area. Dung Bomb combining always succeeds. Time until Frenzy sets in ×0.8
無我の境地: Overcome the Frenzy more easily; while Frenzied-overcome, affinity +15–30%
反動軽減+3: Bowgun recoil 3 levels lighter (not Rapid Fire recoil)
反動軽減+2: Bowgun recoil 2 levels lighter (not Rapid Fire recoil)
反動軽減+1: Bowgun recoil 1 level lighter (not Rapid Fire recoil)
反動軽減-1: Bowgun recoil 1 level heavier (not Rapid Fire recoil)
反動軽減-2: Bowgun recoil 2 levels heavier (not Rapid Fire recoil)
反動軽減-3: Bowgun recoil 3 levels heavier (not Rapid Fire recoil)
装填数UP: Bowgun clip size and Bow charge levels +1 (up to level 4). Also more Gunlance shells and Charge Blade phials
装填速度+3: Bowgun reload 3 levels faster (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings load automatically
装填速度+2: Bowgun reload 2 levels faster (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings load automatically
装填速度+1: Bowgun reload 1 level faster (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings load in ×0.75 the time
装填速度-1: Bowgun reload 1 level slower (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings take ×1.1 the time
装填速度-2: Bowgun reload 2 levels slower (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings take ×1.2 the time
装填速度-3: Bowgun reload 3 levels slower (not for Crouching Fire). Bow coatings take ×1.3 the time
激運: Chance that each quest reward roll hits 22/32 → 31/32
強運: Chance that each quest reward roll hits 22/32 → 28/32
幸運: Chance that each quest reward roll hits 22/32 → 25/32
不運: Chance that each quest reward roll hits 22/32 → 16/32
災難: Chance that each quest reward roll hits 22/32 → 8/32
剥ぎ取り名人: One more carve. No flinching while carving
採取+2: Chance to keep gathering at the same spot 25/32 → 29/32
採取+1: Chance to keep gathering at the same spot 25/32 → 27/32
採取-1: Chance to keep gathering at the same spot 25/32 → 21/32
ハニーハンター: Gather 2 Honey or Royal Honey at a time
お守りハンター: Gathering gives 2 charms 30% of the time
お守り収集: Gathering gives 2 charms 20% of the time
神の気まぐれ: Pickaxes, Bug Nets, horns and Boomerangs don't break 1/2 of the time
精霊の気まぐれ: Pickaxes, Bug Nets, horns and Boomerangs don't break 1/3 of the time
悪霊の気まぐれ: Pickaxes, Bug Nets, horns and Boomerangs break more easily (1/4)
悪魔の気まぐれ: Pickaxes, Bug Nets, horns and Boomerangs break more easily (1/2)
ハンター生活: Easier meat cooking. The minimap shows without a map. Fish bite on the first tug. Bait combining always succeeds
罠師: Traps, meat and bombs (except Small Barrel Bombs and Bounce Bombs) are set faster. Trap and meat combining always succeeds
笛吹き名人: Hunting Horn songs last longer, healing songs heal more. Horn items don't break 1/2 of the time
オトモへの号令: Using "Rally" on a resting Palico heals it fully. Usable again after 10 minutes. No effect with the Last Stand mark
スキル加点+2: Total skill points of the gear +2
高級耳栓: Blocks small and large roars. Roars that deal damage (Tigrex and others) are not blocked
風圧【大】無効: Nullifies minor and major wind pressure, and weakens major dragon wind pressure
耐震: No staggering from large monsters' tremors
広域化+2: Herbs, Potions, Antidotes, Adamant Seeds, Might Seeds and Nulberries also work fully on allies and Palicoes in the same area
広域化+1: Herbs, Potions, Antidotes, Adamant Seeds, Might Seeds and Nulberries also work on allies and Palicoes in the same area (half effect except Antidotes)
細菌研究家: Dung Bombs always make monsters leave the area. Dung Bomb combining always succeeds
